caption: Two stags lock antlers fighting in a Taunus forest clearing near Frankfurt, Germany.

Mont Blanc, France Tourists at an ice cave in the Mer de Glace glacier in the French Alps. The cave entrance is covered with geotextile tarps to slow down melting. The glacier is undergoing accelerated melting due to climate breakdown.
Tokyo, Japan Lee Ju-ho of South Korea swims in the men’s 200m backstroke final at the Asian Games.
Kyiv, Ukraine Rescue personnel carry an injured person after an air attack by Russia.

Jerusalem A man inspects a piece of myrtle at a ‘four species’ market in the ultra-Orthodox neighbourhood of Mea Shearim. Stalls selling the four plant species mentioned in the Torah operate for several days ahead of the eve of Sukkot.
Nagoya, Japan Thailand’s Phutawan Sopa (left) kicks the ball past Malaysia’s Mohamad Azlan Alias during the men’s team sepak takraw gold-medal match.

Kesteren, the Netherlands Protesters set off smoke bombs during an anti-asylum demonstration. Several hundred people gathered at a community centre to protest against plans for asylum seeker centres in the region. Riot police charged the crowd and arrested several people after fireworks were set off.
West Bank People wait in their vehicles at a checkpoint north of Ramallah in the Israeli-occupied territory.
Paris, France Bishops arrive at the Élysée Palace during a four-day visit by Pope Leo XIV to France.

Buenos Aires, Argentina Giselle Correa, a caregiver, hugs Flavio, a resident of the Don Orione Cottolengo residential care facility for people with disabilities, where Pope Leo is scheduled to visit during a trip to Argentina in November.
Taunus region, Germany Stags fighting in a forest near Frankfurt as the rutting season begins.

Manila, Philippines Clarita Alia, whose four sons were victims of alleged extrajudicial killings in Davao City between 2001 and 2007, when Rodrigo Duterte was mayor of the city, holds a candle during the Philippine Truth Commission’s third public session. Human rights advocates have said killings reported in Davao City later served as a template for the nationwide anti-drug campaign Duterte launched after becoming president in 2016.
Mumbai, India Devotees carry idols of the Hindu deities Ganesh and Krishna during the Ganesh Chaturthi festival.
Los Angeles, US William Shatner and his partner, Elizabeth Anderson Martin, at the world premiere of The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World, at the United Theater.
Naples, Italy Yachts in the Gulf of Naples during the 38th America’s Cup preliminary regatta.
Cacau Pirêra, Brazil A firefighter rescues an animal from a wildfire that has burned more than 700 hectares (1,700 acres) in the Amazonian region.
Baltar, Spain Firefighters attempt to extinguish a forest fire close to the town of Xinzo de Limia in the north-west of Spain. The blaze has burned across more than 140 hectares.
Young women hold up their hands in front of the helmets and shields of officers.
Washington, D.C, US Demonstrators shout slogans during a “Free Tibet” protest against Chinese President Xi Jinping’s state visit to the US, outside the Chinese Embassy.
Tynemouth, UK Humans and their dogs frolic on the beach at sunrise in north-east England.

Washington D.C, US U.S. President Donald Trump (R) stands with President of China Xi Jinping during an arrival ceremony at the White House. President Trump is hosting President Xi for a three-day state visit to Washington, DC where the leaders are expected to discuss trade practices, artificial intelligence and furthering “strategic stability” between their countries.
Cape Town, South Africa Demonstrators walk to raise awareness of gender-based violence and femicide after a spate of killings around Johannesburg.
Kathmandu, Nepal Small girls dress as Kumari for a ceremony honouring the ‘living goddess’ at the Indrajatra religious festival.

Bradford, UK A drone view shows volunteers working on the Flower Project which uses more than 300,000 dahlia flowers in a 29-metre wide design by the artist Shiraaz Ali inspired by the area’s textile history.
Gaza City, Gaza A Palestinian girl carries her sister outside her family’s tent in a displacement camp in the neighbourhood of al-Rimal.
Tokyo, Japan Bahrain’s Mikhail Arkhangelskiy (left) and Jaehoon Yang of South Korea at the start of the men’s 50m butterfly final at the Asian Games.
Milan, Italy A model wears a dress shirt repurposed as a dress at Maison Margiela’s Milan fashion week show.

Deir al-Balah, Gaza Smoke and flames rise from a civilian vehicle after a targeted strike by an Israeli unmanned aerial vehicle. At least one Palestinian was killed and several were injured, according to local medical and civil defence sources.
Los Angeles, US A dog is given paws for thought by a food delivery robot in the Californian city.
Ceuta, Spain A young Moroccan migrant stands outside his tent after waking up at the temporary camp at El Trampolín beach, where more than 2,000 people are estimated to be living.
Nagoya, Japan Singapore’s Tia Rozario in action in the women’s triple jump final at the 2026 Asian Games in the Nagoya City Mizuho Park athletics stadium.
Équihen-Plage, France Migrants crowd onboard a smuggler’s boat off the beach.

Sana’a, Yemen Houthi fighters carry pictures of slain comrades as they ride in a funeral procession of decorated trucks. The group recently seized large stretches of the Red Sea coast from Saudi-backed government forces.

London, UK Daniel McCormick performs at the preview of Symphony in Three Movements, Igor Stravinsky’s symphony choreographed by George Balanchine, from Rhythm Riot by English National Ballet at Sadler’s Wells.

Srinagar, India Muslims pray as a relic of Sheikh Syed Abdul Qadir Jilani is displayed at a shrine in Indian Kashmir. Hundreds gather to see the remains of the 11th-century Sufi saint during a festival marking the anniversary of his death.

Madrid, Spain Housing activists stage a sit-down protest outside the apartments from which a disabled 87-year-old woman, Maricarmen, faced eviction after developers bought the block in which she had lived since childhood.
Glastonbury Tor's stone tower atop a grassy hill silhouetted against a fiery orange sunrise.
Nagoya, Japan Singapore’s Emma Yap in action on the balance beam during the artistic gymnastics women’s team final at the Asian Games.
Kyiv, Ukraine Smoke rises after Russian drone strikes around residential buildings.
Paris, France Notre Dame Cathedral decorated with Vatican flags as preparations continue ahead of Pope Leo’s visit.
Rome, Italy Tourists wait to enter the Colosseum, which was closed temporarily after a worker fell to his death on Tuesday while installing cabling inside the ancient amphitheatre.
Nuuk, Greenland Two children play on the beach in the old harbour area.
Glastonbury, UK The sun rises over Glastonbury Tor on the morning of the autumn equinox.
Nagoya, Japan Japan’s Daiki Hashimoto competes on parallel bars in the men’s artistic gymnastics team final during the 2026 Asian Games.
New York, US The US president, Donald Trump, with Japan’s prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, on the sidelines of the 81st UN general assembly.
New York, US Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy looks on during a meeting with Donald Trump on the sidelines of the UN general assembly.
Trishuli, Nepal People walk past as Nepal’s national flag flutters over a damaged house covered in debris and sludge after the 26 August flash flood.

New York, US The Danish prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, and Greenland’s head of government, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, hold a press conference on the roof of the Danish UN mission after the signing of a trilateral Arctic security agreement between the US, Denmark, and Greenland.
Seoul, South Korea Members of civic groups hold up signs opposing the potential dispatch of South Korean troops as they shout slogans during a rally.
Taipei, Taiwan Members of an honour guard perform during a ceremony for the changing of the honour guard at the National Revolutionary Martyrs’ Shrine.
Vilnius, Lithuania People participate in fire rituals to mark the autumn equinox.

Banteay Meanchey, Cambodia A drone view shows Rong Cham, a resettlement site that villagers have nicknamed ‘the waiting village’, home to families who fled fighting along the Cambodia-Thailand border and are waiting for a chance to return.
Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine Flames and smoke rise from the site of an overnight Russian strike on a shopping mall.
